predictive_scope: One2-hour MMS1 interval. All ion moments have qualityflag66 (saturation plus highMach); ion targets excluded before any fit. Electron flags0 and FGMflags0 retained. Moment errors and unmeasured heat flux/geometry limit CGL interpretation. Current density and magnetic field are allowed, so this is a contemporaneous closure rather than future-state forecasting. Eulerian spacecraft samples are not tracked fluid parcels. Two held blocks and one orbit segment do not establish a universal plasma law.
